summary: A click- or hover-triggered popup with a title and description, positionable on any side, with an optional arrow and close button.

props.name: trigger
props.description: The trigger's content - an icon, usually. Pair it with `triggerLabel` when there is no text.

props.name: triggerLabel
props.description: The trigger's `aria-label`. An icon-only trigger has no accessible name without it.

props.name: triggerVariant
props.description: `icon` is a fixed square for a glyph alone; `label` gives the trigger room to pair an icon with text.

props.name: title
props.description: The popup's heading, wired up by Base UI's own Popover.Title.

props.name: description
props.example: Review your recent alerts and updates.
props.description: The body text, wired up by Base UI's own Popover.Description.

props.name: children
props.description: Extra content below the description - a swatch grid, say. Style it yourself.

props.name: side
props.description: Which side of the trigger the popup opens on. It flips automatically if there is no room.

props.name: sideOffset
props.description: Gap between the trigger and the popup, in pixels.

props.name: arrow
props.description: A pointer notched into the popup's edge, aimed back at the trigger. It re-aims itself when `side` changes.

props.name: openOnHover
props.description: Opens on hover as well as click. Consider that a popup which opens on hover is hard to reach on touch.

props.name: delay
props.description: How long a hover must rest before the popup opens, in ms. Ignored unless `openOnHover` is set.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state, for closing the popup from inside `children` - after a selection, say. Uncontrolled (the default) if omitted.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called whenever the popup opens or closes, controlled or not.

props.name: showClose
props.description: An X beside the title. Clicking outside dismisses it either way.

props.name: shape
props.description: Corner radius on the trigger and the popup.

props.name: animated
props.description: The popup's scale-in. Turn it off for an instant popup, or when the user has asked for reduced motion.

props.name: container
props.description: Where the popup is rendered. Defaults to `document.body`, which is right almost always; pass an element to portal somewhere else, such as inside a frame or a container that owns its own stacking context.
